Alright doc, thanks for seeing me. Honestly, I’m not sure what’s going on. It’s been… about three weeks now, maybe a month since the accident on site. And these… visions, I guess? Sometimes I see things, quick flashes, usually out of the corner of my eye. Like people or shadows that aren't there. And sometimes I hear things too, faint whispers, like someone’s calling my name, but no one’s there. It's not constant, but it's enough to throw me off. It's just... A. Acute Stress Disorder
    B. Schizophrenia
    C. Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder
    D. Posttraumatic Stress Disorder
